title: Count Days Without Meetings
statement:
An employee can work on the days numbered `1` through `days`. Each entry `meetings[i] = [start_i, end_i]` books a meeting that occupies every day from `start_i` to `end_i`, both ends included, and different meetings are allowed to overlap.

Return how many of the days from `1` to `days` have no meeting booked on them at all.
notes:
## Intuition

Marking each day on a calendar is the obvious method, but `days` can be a billion. What matters is only where the booked stretches begin and end. Sorted by start day, the meetings can be swept left to right while remembering the furthest day booked so far; any jump past that day leaves a run of free days behind it.

## Approach

1. Sort `meetings` by start day.
2. Set `lastEnd = 0`: nothing before day 1 is booked, and `free = 0`.
3. For each meeting `[start, end]`: if `start > lastEnd + 1`, the days `lastEnd + 1` to `start - 1` are free, so add `start - lastEnd - 1`.
4. Extend coverage with `lastEnd = max(lastEnd, end)`; a meeting nested inside an earlier one must not pull it back.
5. After the loop, days `lastEnd + 1` to `days` are free too: add `days - lastEnd`.

## Example 1, step by step

`days = 10`. Sorted: `[1,3], [5,7], [9,10]`.

- `[1,3]`: `1 > 0 + 1` is false, no gap. `lastEnd = 3`.
- `[5,7]`: `5 > 4`, so day 4 is free: `free = 1`. `lastEnd = 7`.
- `[9,10]`: `9 > 8`, so day 8 is free: `free = 2`. `lastEnd = 10`.
- Tail: `10 - 10 = 0`. The answer is `2`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n log n) for the sort; the sweep is O(n).
- Space: O(1) beyond the sort.

## Pitfalls

- Meetings that only touch (`[1,2]` then `[3,4]`) leave no gap; the test is `start > lastEnd + 1`, not `start > lastEnd`.
- Keep the maximum end: a short meeting inside a long one must not shrink `lastEnd`.
- Do not forget the free days after the last meeting, nor build an array of size `days`.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `free` | number of free days counted so far |
| `lastEnd` | the furthest day covered by any meeting seen so far (0 before the first) |
| `start`, `end` | the current meeting's first and last day |

narration.2: Sort the meetings by their start day so the sweep moves forward in time.
narration.3: No free days have been counted yet.
narration.4: lastEnd = 0 means nothing is booked before day 1.
narration.6: Visit the meetings in order of their start day.
narration.7: Does this meeting start after the day right after the covered stretch?
narration.8: Yes: the days lastEnd + 1 through start - 1 are free; add how many there are.
narration.10: Extend the covered stretch, keeping the larger end so a nested meeting cannot shrink it.
narration.13: Every day after the furthest booked day up to days is free as well.
narration.14: Return the total number of free days.
